name: glassbox
description: Other tools show what happened in a Claude Code session; Glassbox tells you what went wrong. A Stop hook that ends every turn with a one-screen summary (turns, tool calls, context peak, cost, top findings), opt-in feedback of the findings to the agent, and skills to check the current session, open the timeline viewer, or compare two sessions. Local only, no dependencies.

feedback.title: Hand findings back to the agent
feedback.description: Off by default. When on, the Stop hook also gives Claude the findings (with evidence and the "next time" advice) when there are any at or above the threshold; Claude answers in a sentence or two what it would do differently, then stops. Each finding is handed back once per session, and never while Claude is already continuing from a stop hook.

context.title: Carry findings into the next session
context.description: Off by default. When on, the Stop hook writes the findings to <project>/.glassbox/last-session.md (with a .gitignore so it is never committed; deleted after a clean session), and the next session in that project starts with them as context.

fail_on.title: Threshold
fail_on.description: Lowest severity the Stop hook lists (and, with feedback on, hands back): error, warn or info. Default: warn.
